  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  April 25, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281 on April 25, 2024 at 2:01 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Cpt.Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Boytrese Osias / Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Jazmine Covington, Emergency Services / Public Safety

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance department
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on April 11, 2024
Approval of the Minutes of the Special Meeeting held on April 11, 2024

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Katy Nichos on on behalf of LA County Department of Mental Health to host a Take Action
  for Mental Health Event on Market Street between Florence and Manchester Blvd., Public
  Property, on Sunday, May 19, 2024, from 12:00 p.m. – 6:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Applicant to
  adhere to all recommendations outlined by the IPD / Planning Department Department;
  Planning Department/ Public Works Department ;Applicant Approved for one (1) day
  event.; Applicant to hire one (1) Lt.; twelve (12) Ingewood Police Officers; twelve (12)
  TCO’s; must submit the stamped Traffic Control Plan- by the Agency; must have meridian
  barriers; must provide signature for all business near the event area; Maintain site at all
  times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and
  staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County,
  and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00383839)
 Permits & License Committee  April 25, 2024
Minutes  Page 2 of 4

Item #2:  Shana Wilcher on behalf of Florida A&M University (FAMU) to host a Be Out Day LA Event
  at 3400 W. Arbor Vitae St.’ Darby Park, Public Property, on Saturday, September 28,2024,
  from 12:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Applicant to adhere to all recommendations outlined by
  the IPD / Planning Department Department/ Public Works Department; Parks &
  Recreations Department; Applicant Approved for one (1) day event; Applicant to hire six
  (6) Licensed Professional Security Guards; guards must wear reflective vest during the
  event; male/ female security guards must post at the men/ women restrooms during the
  even to prevent any lewd acts; NO alcohol allowed during the event; NO vehicles allowed
  In/ Out of the event; must unload on Pincay ONLY; No more then ten (10) vendor allowed
  at the event; vendors must have health permit cards; Potter potties must have pans; NO
  use of Park outlets must submit all required documents one (1) week before the event;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the
  LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384361)

New Business License Renewal Request (s):
Item #3:  Tony Hasroun DBA Circus Liquor LAX to operate as a Liquor Store at 5014 W CenturyBlvd.
  This Business License has been APPROVED with the following condition set forth
  by the Permits and Licenses Committee:Must adhere to all City of Inglewood Municipal
  Codes (IMC), specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS FOR BUSINESSES
  ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere to all State and
  Federal Rules and Regulations; Retail area not exceed 25% of total retail floor areaSales
  or display of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of Flavored E-Cigarettes , Flavored
  Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored Cartridges, Menthol Cigarettes;
  Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored Smokeless Tobacco Products,
  Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own Tobacco, Flavored Tobacco
  rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly Prohibited;Sales of
  tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is strictly
  prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have a valid
  government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting
  underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or display of any type
  of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly
  prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees are
  subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the day or
  night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to
  enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of Equalization
  Tobacco Retailers license must be current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products
 Permits & License Committee  April 25, 2024

  within existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah
  products) to minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related
  tobacco products SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction
  of underage tobacco use, including hookah products;Submit all state tobacco renewal
  certificates if applicable;NO loitering of persons outside of the location;NO LOITERING /
  PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST BE POSTED and visible to outside of the business. Proof
  of signage posted by applicant shall be submitted to finance (i.e. photo of signage); The
  following is not allowed: the “sales of Whippets are small cylinders of nitrous oxide”, the
  use of or illegal sales or cultivation of marijuana/cannabis products, any regulated cannabis
  products, any use or possession of illegal or unauthorized narcotics, narcotic paraphernalia
  per H&S11364.5 - i.e.; any pipes specifically used to ingest illegal narcotics, this would also
  include glass cylindrical, tube or bubble shaped pipes used specifically to smoke / ingest
  illegal narcotics. Sales of Tobacco pipes are acceptable; Applicant and employees are
  expected to be active participants in calling/notifying police for police related, unusual,
  illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police response or response from other city
  government services (i.e. Code Enforcement, Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept.,
  Etc.);Applicant and employees are expected to be active participants in calling/notifying
  police for police related, unusual, illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police
  response or response from other city government services (i.e. Code Enforcement,
  Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept., Etc.); andThe following is not allowed inside
  the business without proper authorization via the P&L Committee review and permit:
  PARTIES, SOCIAL EVENTS OR GATHERINGS OF ANYKIND, MUSIC BOXES (juke box),
  NO LIVE BANDS / MUSIC, DISC JOCKIES (DJ'S) PERFORMANCE, DANCE HALL, ETC.
  APPLICANT MUST HAVE REASONABLE BUSINESS HOURS (TIME OF DAY OR
  NIGHT) OF OPERATION. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384309)
